meta.name: add-karpathy-llm-wiki
meta.description: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to a NanoClaw group. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Triggers on "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", "llm wiki", "karpathy wiki".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为群组添加持久化知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在群聊中共享和查询持久化的知识库内容。
copy.tagline_en: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to your group
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to share and query a persistent knowledge base in group chats.

howto.what: 在选定的 NanoClaw 群里搭起一个持久 wiki 知识库：建好 wiki/ 与 sources/ 目录、初始 index.md 和 log.md，写出配套的容器技能，并改写群的 CLAUDE.md，让 Claude 之后持续维护这个 wiki。
howto.when: 当你提到“wiki”、“knowledge base”、“karpathy wiki”等关键词，或要求给某个群加一个知识库时触发。

say.text: 给主群加一个 wiki 知识库
我打算往 wiki 里加 PDF、图片和语音
say.note: 会检查这些格式的处理能力，缺的帮你装

say.text: 给 wiki 排一个每周的检查任务
say.note: 用 schedule_task 排定定期 lint

howto.what_en: Sets up a persistent wiki knowledge base in a chosen NanoClaw group: creates wiki/ and sources/ folders, initial index and log files, a container skill, and edits the group's CLAUDE.md so Claude keeps maintaining the wiki.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "wiki", "knowledge base", "karpathy wiki" and similar phrases, or ask to give a group a wiki knowledge base.

say_en.text: Add a wiki knowledge base to my main group
say_en.note: Reads the LLM Wiki pattern, then discusses what to build

say_en.text: I'll be adding PDFs, images, and voice notes
say_en.note: Checks format support and helps install missing skills

say_en.text: Schedule a weekly wiki health check
say_en.note: Sets up a recurring lint task via schedule_task
